name: Together Post-Training
desc: Write RL and SFT loops on Together; it tunes the systems underneath.
desc_zh: 在 Together 上跑自己的 RL 和 SFT 循环，底层系统由平台协同优化。
solves: Training a specialist model means owning the whole RL stack, where one wrong setting silently wastes a run; here you write the loop and the platform handles the infrastructure.
solves_zh: 训练专用模型要自己扛下整条 RL 栈，一个参数设错就悄悄毁掉一轮；这里你只写循环，基础设施交给平台。
best_for: You have environment rewards or supervision data for a narrow task and want a model tuned for it without renting a cluster.
best_for_zh: 手上有一个窄任务的环境奖励或监督数据，想据此调出一个模型，又不想为此租一整批机器。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.together.ai/blog (Model Shaping category) and https://www.togeth）。 Announced 2026-10-19, inside the window; not in the ledger. The docs carry SFT, DPO and GRPO quickstarts. Distinct from the older Together fine-tuning product: the announcement frames Post-Training as owning the training loop rather than launching managed jobs. Second source is the same publisher. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.together.ai/blog/together-post-training
